## Requirement and agreed scope

State the institutional purpose, files changed, and authorization.

## Implementation and risk

Describe the change, dependencies and provenance, affected users, migration or rollback implications.

## Confidentiality and AI assistance

- [ ] Any AI assistance disclosed; changes manually reviewed.
- [ ] Only synthetic/sanitized data used; no real client records or secrets supplied to AI.
- [ ] No .env files, tokens, private credentials or production deployment access involved.
- [ ] Package origin, maintainer, license and dependency risks checked.

## Evidence

- [ ] Staged/tracked preflight clean.
- [ ] Security unit tests clean.
- [ ] Static site builds and generated changes verified.
- [ ] Gitleaks and CodeQL reports reviewed.
- [ ] Relevant browser, accessibility and regression evidence supplied.

## Approval

Independent reviewer:
Institutional content approval:
Security review:
Release and rollback owner:
Open blockers:

Do not merge when security, ownership or approval gates are unresolved.
